description: Make a symbol from artwork (Symbols panel > New Symbol) with a registration point. By default the artwork is replaced by an instance of the new symbol, as the panel does. Several items become one symbol, or one symbol each with each: true

each.description: One symbol per item instead of one for all. Default false

name.description: Symbol name. With each: true, items are numbered after it ("Leaf 1", "Leaf 2"). Default: Illustrator names it

registration.description: Registration point on the symbol's bounding box. Default center

replace.description: Replace the artwork with an instance of the symbol. Default true

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: create_symbol
title: Create Symbol
